# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONTINUATION_BULL

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP continuation edge is a robust phenomenon where the first 3 RTH closes being on the same side of the session VWAP indicates a directional bias for the session, and the first morning bar that continues in-trend can be a profitable entry.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves checking the first 3 RTH closes to determine if they are all on the same side of the session VWAP. If they are, and the next bar continues in-trend, an entry is triggered. The entry is a limit order at mid, with a stop-loss at the chart stop (primary invalidation) and a take-profit target at +50% of the entry premium.
